correctness.rationale: The line/leaf decomposition follows from multiplication equations for all m>=2; the full matrix conditions are necessary and sufficient. Orthogonal order types follow from explicit Gram determinant classes. Exhaustive prime-field small tests and the modular q=5,m=5 witness agree.

originality.rationale: The 2018/2020 graph evolution algebra references determine derivation spaces, and the 2025 automorphism paper describes symmetry actions and a diagonal star subgroup but does not provide these full rational-point orders. Database searches returned no equivalent star-family group formula. Structural comparison distinguishes graph symmetries and diagonal factors from the full conformal orthogonal stabilizer and its isotropic parabolic factor. No global priority proof is asserted.
residual_risks: An equivalent theorem could occur under conformal orthogonal stabilizers or automorphism groups of bilinear-form algebras, not tagged as star evolution algebras.
The 2020 derivation paper was accessible only through abstract/bibliographic scope; an unexpected automorphism application in its full text cannot be wholly excluded.

The 2025 work is over algebraically closed characteristic-zero fields whereas this theorem concerns finite odd fields, so differences in field hypotheses are substantive and comparison is by implication, not identical assumption sets.
